description: Prepare ONE private message to an event host, not an event RSVP. Supply eventId, stable requestId, explicit replyEmail, message and topic question/tickets/refund/volunteering/accessibility/collaboration. Use only facts the person wants included, never private memories/transcripts by default. Returns the exact message, recipient label, email-sharing disclosure, requestId and reviewHash. Show the full review and ask to send. Sends nothing. Draft expires in 30 minutes; changed content needs a new requestId.
name: prepare_host_contact
title: Prepare Host Contact
